chunks: My father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with them) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) from the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), who said:
The dwelling of Adam and Eve in Paradise was only until they were expelled from it, for seven hours according to the days of the world, until God sent them down on that very day of theirs.
ai.seo_question: How long did Adam and Eve stay in Paradise before being sent down to Earth?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* specifies that Adam and Eve’s stay in Paradise lasted only seven hours of earthly time, a detail emphasized by Shia scholars to illustrate the brevity of their bliss before the Fall. The hadith underscores the concept of *tabdil al-awqat* (transformation of time), where celestial duration differs from terrestrial measurement, reinforcing the transient nature of Paradise for humans.
